body.title: Provider retry switch: internalRetry
body.summary: Add the optional internalRetry to StructuredCompletionOpts and ReviewSessionOpts and signal to ReviewSessionOpts, add the optional attempts parameter to CliProvider.withTransientRetry, and map internalRetry false to exactly one attempt in CliProvider.completeStructured, CliProvider.runReviewSession (no transient or stall retry) and OllamaProvider.completeStructured. When absent, behaviour is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: internalRetry false makes exactly one CLI run or Ollama request on each of the three paths.
Without the field, today's retry counts are unchanged.

tests.name: src/agent/providers/__tests__/internal-retry.test.ts: 'internalRetry false makes exactly one attempt on CliProvider completeStructured, runReviewSession and OllamaProvider completeStructured; absent keeps today's counts'
